FIELDS.NAME: Precision Auto Repair & Body Shop
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Precision Auto Repair & Body Shop specializes in routine maintenance and light mechanical repairs for private passenger vehicles and pickups, such as oil changes, tire rotations, and brake inspections. Our operation also includes a dedicated body shop for cosmetic repairs and paintwork, ensuring vehicles are restored to their original condition. We prioritize a controlled environment free from heavy truck and commercial vehicle repairs, which helps minimize risk and maintain a high standard of service. Our certified technicians uphold industry standards for quality and safety, engaging in ongoing training to stay current with best practices. We operate in a suburban area with low crime rates, supported by robust environmental compliance programs for waste disposal and hazardous materials management, ensuring regulatory compliance. Additionally, our workflow is organized through a scheduled appointment system that effectively manages service demand and reduces congestion. With secure storage for vehicles and an emphasis on customer-focused service, we strive to build long-lasting relationships with our local clientele.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss dates: January 2023, cause: minor vehicle collision during a routine repair, amount: $2,000, status: resolved. Loss dates: March 2023, cause: environmental compliance audit resulted in fines, amount: $1,500, status: paid.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Saturday: 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM, closed on Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Fireproof safe, Class B, UL certified, with a capacity of 2 cubic feet.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Secure fencing and 24-hour surveillance for vehicle storage.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – We do not store, treat, discharge, apply, dispose of, or transport hazardous materials in our operations, as we focus solely on routine maintenance and light mechanical repairs for private passenger vehicles. Our environmental compliance programs ensure adherence to all relevant regulations concerning hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: Yes – We sponsor local athletic teams as part of our community engagement efforts. This allows us to build relationships and support youth activities in the area.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are typically checked by a designated member of the management team to ensure compliance and adequate coverage.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions related to fraud, bribery, arson, or any arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property for the applicant.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – There have been no policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. The business has maintained consistent insurance coverage without issues.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – We do not lease employees to or from other employers as part of our operations. Our staff is fully employed by Precision Auto Repair & Body Shop.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – We carry Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with state regulations and provide coverage for our employees.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – The business owner operates another business, Precision Auto Parts Supply, which complements the services offered at Precision Auto Repair & Body Shop.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – The business currently does not maintain any other insurance policies with this company.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – We are not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our focus is solely on routine maintenance and light mechanical repairs for private passenger vehicles.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – We do not rent or loan equipment to others; our operations focus solely on providing services for our customers' vehicles. This helps us maintain control over our equipment and minimizes potential liabilities.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – There have been no foreclosures, repossessions, bankruptcies, judgments, or liens against the applicant in the past five years. The financial standing of the business has been stable and compliant.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – We do not have exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus on routine maintenance and light mechanical repairs for private passenger vehicles, ensuring a safe environment.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Our operations do not involve any exposure to catastrophe risks, as we specialize solely in routine maintenance and light mechanical repairs for private passenger vehicles in a controlled suburban environment.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – There have been no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business maintains a strong focus on compliance and safe practices in all operations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – There are no uncorrected fire code violations; the business is committed to maintaining a safe environment and complies with all fire safety regulations.
